scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:version && npm run test:icons --prefix frontend && npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend -- --watch=false
